meta.title: Protocol for printing 3D neural tissues using the BIO X equipped with a pneumatic printhead.

extracted_by: Claude (Claude Code session), pending human review
summary: A step-by-step protocol from the Willerth lab for printing neural tissues with Axolotl Biosciences' fibrin-based bioink on a CELLINK BIO X pneumatic printhead, either onto plates or into an agarose support bath.

formulations.name: Axolotl fibrin bioink on BIO X (protocol)
formulations.composition_detail: Fibrin-based bioink (Axolotl Biosciences); 2% alginate / 2% gelatin mixture also described
formulations.key_outcome: Recommended 15 mm/s at 11 kPa on plates, 20 mm/s at 20 kPa into agarose support bath.

evidence.quote: A speed of 15 mm/s and pressure of 11 kPa is recommended.
A speed of 20 mm/s and a pressure of 20 kPa is recommended.
A mixture of 2% alginate/2% gelatin (w/v) is typically produced.
